904.EnglishLong: Increases the fixed chance to trigger Weak Point Strike by 10%.

Successful Block restores 2% HP and 3 Rage, once per second.

907.EnglishLong:
Successful Block triggers Countercrush, once per second.
On Lucky Block, trigger Enhanced Countercrush, once per second.

911.EnglishLong:
Reduces the CD of Sandstone Grasp by 15s.
After using Sandgrip, gains Countercrush.

913.EnglishLong: During Brave Bastion, doubles the Block chance.

914.EnglishLong: Successful hit of Shield Bash reduces the DMG targets deal to you by 3% for 10s, stacking up to 3 times.

916.EnglishLong: While shielded, use Basic Attack midair to slam down, detonating the Shield and dealing DMG equal to 30% max HP to nearby enemies. Once every 30s.

917.EnglishLong: Increases the effectiveness of Shield granted by Shield Bash by 30%.

918.EnglishLong: During Stoneform, gains Sandy Shelter for every 20 Rage accumulated.

921.EnglishLong: While shielded, reduces Magic Damage taken by 25% and Wind DMG taken by 50%.

922.EnglishLong: During Sandshroud, gaining a shield triggers Shield Echo.

When dealing DMG, Granite Fury has a 20% chance to allow your next Basic Attack to evolve into Rageblow. Each 2% Luck adds 1% chance.
After using Rageblow, increases Block DMG RED by 10% for 10s.

924.EnglishLong: Reduces the DMG Elites or stronger enemies deal to you by 12%.

926.EnglishLong: Each enemy within 3 meters increases Block chance by 3%, up to 15%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.)

927.EnglishLong: During Enraged, increases Armor by 30%, yet it loses 5% per second.

928.EnglishLong: Each enemy within 3 meters enhances Suppress effect by 3%, up to 15%. (Doubles the effect against Elite or stronger enemies.)

929.EnglishLong: Consuming Rage has a chance to trigger Enraged. Each 1 Rage consumed grants 1% chance.

930.EnglishLong:
Replace Special Attack with Countercrush, and enhance the ability.
When Lucky Block triggers, increases Block DMG RED by 10%.

Try to keep Countercrush active as much as possible. While it's active, part of incoming DMG can be blocked. High Luck allows parry to yield various buffs.

931.EnglishLong:
Further enhances Shield Bash.
Each additional enemy hit increases the DMG deal by Shield Bash by 30%, up to 150%.

932.EnglishLong: Tectonic Ring generates a Sandfield that lasts 5s.

933.EnglishLong: When Rageblow deals DMG, reduces the CD of Brave Bastion by 3s.

934.EnglishLong: During Brave Bastion, using Countercrush or Granite Fury triggers a Sand Crystal Shock.

935.EnglishLong: A successful Block grants you a fixed 30% chance that your next Granite Fury won't consume Sand Crystal. Once every 3s.

937.EnglishLong: In enraged state, Suppress effect is doubled.

939.EnglishLong: For every Sand Crystal consumed, recover 1% of Max HP.

941.EnglishLong:
Rage Burst charge +1.
While Enraged, Rage Burst becomes instant cast.

942.EnglishLong: Star Shatter damage +30%, and always gains enraged.

943.EnglishLong:
During the duration of Sandshroud, being attacked reduces the attack speed of enemy targets within 5 meters by 30%, lasting for 3s.
During the duration of Sandshroud, Armor of friendly targets within 8 meters +10%.

944.EnglishLong: When normal attacks deal damage, 10% chance to trigger Rock Shield, this effect can occur once every 30s.

945.EnglishLong: During the duration of Stoneform, all damage received -10%.

948.EnglishLong: For every 20 Sand Crystals consumed, Star Shatter evolves into Starfall.

949.EnglishLong:
After Casting Starfall Arcane, gain Rock Master.
Rock Master: For 15s, normal attacks evolve into 1 Arcane, and Rage Burst evolves into 1 Terra Sunder.

951.EnglishLong: In Enraged state, Arcane is guaranteed to trigger Weak Point Strike.

953.EnglishLong:
For every 7 Enrages, gain Rock Master.
Rock Master: For 15s, normal attacks evolve into 1 Arcane, and Rage Burst evolves into 1 Terra Sunder.

954.EnglishLong: In combat state, recover 1% of max HP every 5s.

955.EnglishLong:
Armor +300.
Terra Sunder additionally deals Attack Damage to the target equal to 200% of Armor.

956.EnglishLong: During Brave Bastion, Granite Fury and Countercrush damage +30%.

957.EnglishLong: When triggering Lucky Block, Defense for this block +30%.

After Casting Granite Fury 5 times, gain Rock Heart.
Rock Heart: For 10s, Granite Fury evolves into Stone Fist.

961.EnglishLong: For every 50 Rage generated, summon 1 Rock Bullet.

965.EnglishLong: Rock Bullet has a chance to summon an additional Rock Bullet, with the chance equal to Lucky Chance.

966.EnglishLong: Rock Bullet hitting a target reduces all damage dealt to me by that target by -10% for the next 5s.

967.EnglishLong:
Every 20 rock bullets summoned grants a Heart of Rock.
Heart of Rock: For 10s, Granite Fury transforms into Stone Fist.

968.EnglishLong: For 10s after Casting Tectonic Ring, triggers Enhanced Block Counter every 2s.

969.EnglishLong:
Luck chance +5%.
Block Counter and Enhanced Block Counter are guaranteed Crits.

When Wildpack Spec is active, increases Max Photon Energy by 20, and extends the duration of Photon Reforge.
If Falconry Spec is active, reduces Max Photon Energy by 20, and enables faster access to Photon Reforge.

1107.EnglishLong:
When Wildpack Spec is active, reduces Photon Energy drain during Photon Reforge from 25 to 20 per second.
If Falconry Spec is active, increases Photon Energy regain from 2 to 3 per second, speeding up activation of Photon Reforge via time-based mechanics.

The Wild Wolf's Coordinated Attack grants a fixed 30% chance to summon a Phantom Direwolves, which pounces on the enemy.
Pounce and Bite always inflicts Bleed. If the target is already bleeding, the pounce is bound to deal Crit DMG.

1115.EnglishLong: Extends the duration of Focus by 3s.

Applies Swiftness to Falcon when using Lightning Strike.
Swiftness: Increases Attack SPD by 10%. The effect lasts 8s and stacks up to 3 times.

1118.EnglishLong: Every 3 Crit hits with Double Arrow allows the Falcon to instantly perform Lightning Strike.

1119.EnglishLong:
When the Falcon strikes, grants you a fixed 30% chance to gain 1 stack of Weak Point Aim.
Using Quadraflare leaves behind a Radiance Rift midair. The Rift consumes the stacks of Weak Point Aim to fire Photon Arrows, each dealing Attack Damage equal to 80% ATK.

1121.EnglishLong: The Falcon ignores 20% of the targets' Armor.

1122.EnglishLong:
Every 1% critical rate grants 0.3% Crit DMG.
Crit hits of Double Arrow grants 2 Photon Energy.

1123.EnglishLong: Every target hit grants 1% Light DMG bonus. The effect lasts 3s and stacks up to 4 times.

1124.EnglishLong: Companions deal 8% more DMG to Elites or stronger enemies.

Enhances usage of Storm Arrow and synergy with the Wild Wolf.
When Photon Reforge is not activated, using Storm Arrow grants the Wild Wolf a fixed 25% chance to launch a Coordinated Attack. During Photon Reforge, doubles the chance.

1127.EnglishLong: Basic Attacks grants a 20% fixed chance to fire extra arrows at up to 3 nearby enemies.

1128.EnglishLong: Basic Attacks gains a fixed 15% chance to generate Split Arrow. Once per second.

Replaces Special Attack with Double Arrow, and enhances the ability to use this skill.
Recovers 2 points of Photon Energy per second.
Every 1% haste provides 1% CD Speed Increase for Double Arrow.

1130.EnglishLong:
After you use Arrow Rain, the Wild Wolf continuously sweeps its tail until the storm ends.
Tail Sweep is bound to deal Crit DMG and inflicts Bleed.

1131.EnglishLong: When dealing DMG, Basic or Special Attacks gain a fixed 10% chance to fire an Explosive Arrow. Once every 3s.

Companion damage +2%.
Within 5s after Casting Torrent Volley, Companion damage +10%.

1138.EnglishLong: Each time a wolf or phantom wolf is summoned, Arrow Rain's remaining CD -0.5s.

1139.EnglishLong: For each additional bleed effect on the target, the wolf's damage to that target +3%.

1140.EnglishLong: The wolf's coordinated attack reduces Storm Arrow's remaining CD by 1s.

1141.EnglishLong: Light Chasing Arrow has a 50% fixed chance to inflict bleed on the target.

1142.EnglishLong: The wolf evolves into an adult form, damage +30%, damage range +50%.

1144.EnglishLong: In Photon Reforge state, Torrent Volley continuously charges, and after 30s of charging, it evolves into Lumi Torrent.

1145.EnglishLong: Each time a Light Chasing Arrow is shot, Wild Call's remaining CD -1s.

1148.EnglishLong: Arrow Rain and Light Chasing Arrow are guaranteed to critically hit.

1150.EnglishLong: Damage of the demon wolf to targets with HP less than or equal to 35% increased by 30%.

1151.EnglishLong: Within 10s after Casting Wild Call, Casting Wild Call again can command all pets on the field to immediately cast Trample.

1152.EnglishLong: When you and the falcon deal Crit DMG, apply 1 layer of Steel Beak to the target.

1153.EnglishLong: Every 5 triggers of Implosion summon a phantom falcon to rush towards the target.

1154.EnglishLong: During the duration of Focus, +0.5% Crit and +1% Crit DMG every second, this effect can stack up to 12 layers.

1155.EnglishLong: When Double Arrow hits critically, reduce the remaining CD time of Blast Shot and Powerdraw by 1s.

1157.EnglishLong:
Radiance Barragehitting the target applies Light Stasis to it.
Light Stasis: Speed -30%, guaranteed Crit when hit by Powerdraw, lasts for 5s.

1158.EnglishLong: When the falcon hits critically, ignore 50% of the target's Armor.

1159.EnglishLong: When the falcon triggers Coordinated Attack, agility +20 for 5s, can stack up to 10 layers.

1160.EnglishLong: During the duration of Focus, Radiance Barrage summons a celestial eagle at the target's location.

1161.EnglishLong: Each arrow fired by Radiance Rift that deals damage increases the damage of the next Blast Shot by +10%, up to a maximum of 100%.

1162.EnglishLong:
Lightning Strike hitting the target triggers Prism.
Prism: Deals chain damage equal to 100% ATK to up to 5 surrounding enemy targets, additionally applies 3 layers of Steel Beak.

1165.EnglishLong: Powerdraw hitting the target applies 2 layers of Steel Beak, if it hits critically, applies 5 layers of Steel Beak.

1166.EnglishLong: When the celestial eagle hits the target, Steel Beak on the target will not naturally decrease.

1200.EnglishLong: Consumes Holy Sigils to activate Lightforged Body. Each additional Holy Sigil consumed grants a Radiant shield equal to 100% ATK.

1205.EnglishLong: Each 1% Haste accelerates the REG SPD of Holy Sigils by 1%.

1207.EnglishLong: Within the Divine Circle, Condemn evolves into Enhanced Condemn, dealing 100% more DMG.

1210.EnglishLong:
Unleashes a water vortex at the target's feet, continuously dealing Magic Damage to enemies within range. Each time DMG is dealt, for every 1 target hit, restore 2 Ice Energy. A maximum of 10 Ice Energy can be restored per hit.

Ultra Cold Vortex
While in the Ultra Cold state, the water vortex will freeze and violently explode upon ending, dealing higher Magic Damage to all enemies within range.

Tips: Pair with Ray Stream. Casting at the right moment can restore considerable Ice Energy.

1211.EnglishLong:
Casts a slow-moving water orb and gains 1 Frost Crystal immediately, and 1 Frost Crystal every 3s thereafter. On impact, the orb's velocity decays. While the aqueous orb persists, it continuously deals Magic Damage to all nearby enemies and applies Frost to them.

Ultra Cold Crystal Veil
While in the Ultra Cold, the water orb will freeze and violently explode upon ending, dealing higher Magic Damage to all enemies within range.

This skill holds 2 charges.

Tips: At least one charge shall be maintained at all times, unless Ice Energy exceeds its maximum capacity. It is recommended to maintain two charges before casting the Ultimate, as combining it with Ultra Cold grants bonus DMG.

1212.EnglishLong:
Using Shield Toss grants the Lightforged Body a Light Shield equal to 300% ATK.
Increases the charge of Shield Toss by 1.

1214.ChineseShort: 博伊斯协同子弹触发被动

1215.EnglishLong:
While Aegis Ward is active, doubles your Block chance.
When you take DMG, reduces Aegis Ward's CD by 0.2s. Once every 0.5s.

1217.EnglishLong: After using Ultimate, creates a Holy Barrier, shielding nearby allies from DMG. It lasts for 15s or until it absorbs DMG equal to 200% Max HP.

1220.EnglishLong: When Vanguard Strike deals damage, 20% chance that the next Judgment within 5s will consume 50% less Light Energy and will definitely deal Crit DMG.

1226.EnglishLong: During Zeal Crusade, gains 1 stack of Lightforged Barrier per second and each Holy Decree consumed grants Zeal Crusade 1 charge. When 3 charges are reached, Zeal Crusade explodes outward, dealing 200% Attack Damage and guaranteed Crit.

1227.EnglishLong: For each enemy target within the Divine Circle, Divine Circle damage +25%, Divine Circle Healing +5%.

1228.EnglishLong: When Judgment hits only one enemy target, damage +25%.

1229.EnglishLong: While within the Divine Circle, self-Healing are +10%.

1232.EnglishLong: During Ultimate duration, threat generated by Allies is transferred to you.

1233.EnglishLong: When Strength reaches 500 points, Max HP +12%.

1234.EnglishLong: When Condemn deals damage, immediately cool down 1 Holy Decree (prioritizing the one with the longest remaining CD).

1235.EnglishLong: When Expertise critically heal, gain 15% healing bonus.

1236.EnglishLong: Valor Bash can be charged by holding down, then rush forward a certain distance.

1237.EnglishLong: When Inferno Reckon or Reckoning deals Crit DMG to an enemy target, block chance +5%, lasts for 10s, stacks up to 5 times.

1239.EnglishLong:
Consumes 5 Ice Energy to instantly summon 3 Meteor Storms above the target, dealing Magic Damage to the target and surrounding enemies.
This skill holds 2 charges.

Tips: This instant-cast DMG skill is best utilized in a highly mobile style of combat to maximize DMG dealt through repeated use.

1240.EnglishLong:
Unleashes built-up cold energy in a violent surge, dealing Magic Damage and inflicting Frozen on nearby enemies.
Charging the skill alters both its range and DMG.
Tier 1: Chants for 1 sec, targeting a 8m frontal cone.
Tier 2: Chants for 2 secs, targeting a 8m frontal cone with 50% increased DMG.
Tier 3: Chants for 3 secs, targeting a 8m frontal cone with 100% increased DMG.
When holding 1 / 3 / 5 Frozen, the skill will instantly cast at Tier 1 / 2 / 3, skipping the charge time.

Tips: This skill offers both area damage and crowd control. For best results, cast it when you have high Frost Crystal count.

1241.EnglishLong:
Consumes 15 Ice Energy to launch a concentrated ice beam toward the target, dealing Magic Damage to all enemies in its path every 0.3s. After dealing DMG 5 instances, the beam attempts to consume additional Ice Energy to sustain itself. Every 12 Ice Energy extends the beam by 0.3s and deals 1 additional instance of DMG. Each time Frostbeam deals DMG, it increases its own DMG by 8%, up to 80%. (Beam terminates when Ice Energy drops below 3.)
Frostbeam's firing interval is affected by Haste.

Tips: Cast when Ice Energy is near maximum capacity for extended beam duration. While firing, use the joystick to make minor positioning adjustments.

1242.EnglishLong:
Chants for 1.4s, then consumes 10 Ice Energy to fire a sharp Frost Lance at the target, dealing Magic Damage on impact.
Allows the consumption of 1 Frost Crystal to skip chanting and to increase DMG by 20%.

Tips: Cast Frost Lance regularly to avoid wasting excess Energy.

1243.EnglishLong:
Summon the Strength of Ice to generate 6 Ice Energy per second and increase Haste for the duration.

Tips: Increases ATK and casting speed. Since this skill generates Ice Energy, avoid using it when Ice Energy is near maximum, or quickly spend Ice Energy afterward.

1244.EnglishLong:
Chants for 2.9s, then consumes 20 Ice Energy to summon an intense Blizzard at the target location, continuously dealing Magic Damage and applying Frost to all enemies within the area.

Tips: This devastating AoE skill is most effective when used against immobilized enemies to maximize DMG dealt.

1245.EnglishLong:
Encase the caster in ice, and make caster immune to all DMG but are unable to move for the duration. Deals Magic Damage to all nearby enemies, and inflicts Slow, which upgrades to Freeze.

Tips: This skill is intended to be equipped in high-pressure situations to increase survivability.

1246.EnglishLong:
Summon a surging Tidal Vortex at the target location, dealing Magic Damage on impact. Channels for 5s after casting. Can be manually canceled by casting again.

Ultra Cold: Tidepool
During the Ultra Cold state, the vortex Frozens upon ending and explodes, dealing higher Magic Damage to all enemies within range.

Tips: You cannot move or cast other skills while channeling. Best paired with allies' AoE skills in coordinated attacks.

1248.EnglishLong:
Summon the ice's blessing to unfold an Ice Domain, knocking all enemies back within the range. Then summons a comet to strike the targets, dealing Magic Damage and inflicting Freeze on all affected enemies.
Ice Domain
Within the Domain, restores 220 Ice Energy over time and gains Ultra Cold. Enemies within the domain are continuously Slowed, escalating to Freeze.
While in Ultra Cold, targets are treated as Freeze.

Tips: Casting should be avoided when Ice Energy approaches its maximum capacity, otherwise the Ice Energy will be quickly depleted. The skill is best casted within the range of Ultra Cold

1264.EnglishLong: Gain 5% Light bonus while in Lightforged Body state.

1300.EnglishLong:

1306.EnglishLong: After using 3 Special Attacks, the next Basic Attack hit triggers Flame Pillar Blast.

1308.EnglishLong: While in Rhapsody of Flame, your Luck chance is doubled.

1309.EnglishLong: Gains 1 Soundwave Energy whenever Expertise or Amplified Beat trigger a Lucky Strike.

1310.EnglishLong:
Rhapsody of Flame always appears in its most powerful form.
While in Rhapsody of Flame, healing +20%.

1311.EnglishLong: Each time Fierce Strike deals DMG, there's a fixed 50% chance to reset Harmonic Anthem's CD (which can only be triggers once on multiple hits).

1312.EnglishLong:
Gains 1 Soundwave Energy each time you deal DMG equal to 10 times ATK.
When consuming Performance Passion, launches Fireball that consumes all Soundwave Energy. Each 1 point of Soundwave Energy increases Fireball DMG by 20%.

1313.EnglishLong:
Basic Attacks become a two-hit combo.
For every 5 Soundwave Energy obtained, creates a Note for the Ally with the lowest HP.

1314.EnglishLong: Stores excess Healing (up to 500% of Max HP). After activating Heroic Melody, consumes stored Healing to recover allies' HP every 1s, up to 15% of Max HP per second.

1315.EnglishLong:
While in Rhapsody of Flame, your Amplified Beat attack count +1.
While in Rhapsody of Flame, each hit of Harmonic Anthem also heals 1 ally with the lowest HP.

1316.EnglishLong: When DMG Expertise trigger Lucky Strike (triggers only once when hitting multiple targets), immediately resets Rhapsody of Flame's CD and makes it cost no Performance Passion for 10s.

1318.EnglishLong: When Healing Beat or Passion Burst applies Crit Healing or deals Crit DMG (triggers only once when hitting multiple targets), gains 1 Performance Passion.

1319.EnglishLong: Healing Beat provides an additional Healing to targets under the influence of Healing Melody.

1321.EnglishLong:
Healing Beat Crit Rate +10%.
Healing Beat Healing +10%.

1322.EnglishLong: Every 1% Crit Rate grants 1% trigger chance for Encore Strings.

1323.EnglishLong: For each 10 Performance Passion consumed, enhances Passion Burst to Passion Burst for 10s.

1324.EnglishLong: While Healing Melody is active, grants allies appropriate buffs (Strength, Intellect, Agility) equal to 10% of Intellect. (Buffs from different Beat Performers cannot stack. Only one with the highest value applies.)

1325.EnglishLong: When each Passion Burst Healing crits, doubles the buffs that Healing Melody provides to allies.

1326.EnglishLong: Fire Bonus +8% when attacking Elite or higher targets.

1327.EnglishLong: During Center Stage, triggering Encore Strings has a 30% fixed chance to grant Passion Surge.

1331.EnglishLong: When Encore Strings triggers, it activates a second time on the same target.

1338.EnglishLong: Every 1% Luck grants 2% Lucky Strike DMG Multiplier.

1339.EnglishLong: When a Note forms, there's a 50% fixed chance to create an extra Note for a different target.

1340.EnglishLong: When Expertise deal DMG (only triggers once when hitting multiple targets), heal targets with Note.

1341.EnglishLong: Converted healing from DMG +20% for targets affected by Note.

1342.EnglishLong: While Heroic Melody is active, Rhapsody of Flame becomes explosive, dealing DMG every 3s to targets it touches (interval affected by Haste).

1343.EnglishLong: When casting an Expertise Skill, Rhapsody of Flame releases Magic Damage equal to 100% ATK and grants a Note to allies it touches.

1344.EnglishLong: Within 10s of casting Encore, each use of Rhapsody of Flame causes targets affected by Encore to trigger Encore Strings.

1345.EnglishLong:
Permanently benefits from Encore effect.
For every 5 triggers of Encore Strings, the next Amplified Beat or Harmonic Anthem deals 50% more DMG.

1346.EnglishLong: Every 1% Luck Chance grants 1% more trigger chance for Encore Strings.

1347.EnglishLong: Encore Strings' Lucky Strike DMG and healing +50%.

1349.EnglishLong:
Center Stage charge +1.

1356.EnglishLong: While Healing Melody is active, Fivefold Crescendo gains a DMG effect.

1357.EnglishLong: Expertise triggered by the speaker gain 30% more DMG and healing.

1358.EnglishLong: Per second Healing Melody remains active, its Healing +2%, stacking up to 5 times.

1359.EnglishLong:
Crit +10% against enemies above 50% HP.
Crit +10% against enemies below 50% HP.

1363.EnglishLong:

Center Stage charge +1.

1409.EnglishLong:
Launches into enemy lines, dealing Attack Damage to enemies in range and knocking them Airborne. Restores 100 Courage.
"Endless storm, unlock thy mighty power at my knight's command! Wind, reveal thy glory with a surging rush!"

Tips: Cast when Courage is low.

1410.EnglishLong:
Raise the banner spear, applying Inspire to Allies before a follow-up leap can be launched, dealing Attack Damage to the enemies within range and knocking them airborne, while restoring 100 Courage.
Inspire: Lasts for 10s. During this time, all Allies' Haste +10%. You restore 10 Courage per second and 1 stack of Sharpness every 2s.
"Endless storm, unlock thy mighty power at my knight's command! Wind, reveal thy glory with a surging rush! Manifest in the wind!

Tips: Cast when Courage is low.

1411.EnglishLong:
Deals Attack Damage equal to 100% ATK to all the enemies, which scales with the Level/Tier of Basic Attack.
Restores 10 Courage immediately upon use.

1418.EnglishLong:
Consumes 50 Courage to perform 3 thrusts toward the enemy, dealing Attack Damage with each hit.

Tips: Time casts carefully, and use this skill between Basic Attacks, as Courage takes time to accumulate.

1419.EnglishLong:
Consumes 35 Courage to leap into the air and deliver a downward strike on the enemy, dealing Attack Damage.
"Even if enemy lines are unbreakable, the wind of victory will tear them asunder!"

Tips: Cast when Courage is near cap. When casting in succession, the leap is skipped for faster follow-up attacks.

1420.EnglishLong:
Stuns enemies in front upon casting, dealing Attack Damage. While active, continuously restores 105 Courage and increases your Strength.
This skill holds 2 charges.

Tips: Cast when Courage is low.

Upon impact with an enemy or reaching maximum range, the arrow explodes, dealing continuous Attack Damage to all enemies in the blast area, creating a gravity effect, and inflicting Vulnerability and Rooted.

Tips: An excellent crowd-control skill that can be decisive in multi-target engagements.

2212.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-极限闪避_前

2213.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-极限闪避_后

2214.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-武器切换技

2220.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-特殊攻击A
2220.EnglishLong:
Quickly draws the bow to fire 5 arrows at the target, each dealing Attack Damage and generating 1 Photon Energy.
This skill holds 2 charges. When
Photon Energy reaches max, Storm Arrow instantly gains 2 charges, and the max number of charges increases to 5.

Tips: Even after five uses, Storm Arrow will continue to re-charge. Use other skills to buy time for more casts.

2221.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-特殊攻击A_SP
2221.EnglishLong:
Quickly draws the bow to fire 5 arrows at the target, each dealing Attack Damage and generating 1 Photon Energy.
This skill holds 2 charges. When
Photon Energy reaches max, Storm Arrow instantly gains 2 charges, and the max number of charges increases to 5.

Tips: Even after five uses, Storm Arrow will continue to re-charge. Use other skills to buy time for more casts.

2222.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-特殊攻击B
2222.EnglishLong:
Slides sideways and quickly shoots 2 arrows, dealing Attack Damage.
In Photon Reforge state, Double Arrow evolves into Quadraflare, leaping into the air and firing 4 empowered arrows that deal high Attack Damage with doubled critical rate.
This skill holds 3 charges.

Tips: Keep an eye on the Photon Reforge state and use ​Quadraflare​ at the right moment.

2223.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-特殊攻击B_下落

2230.EnglishLong:
Continuously draws bow to launch a barrage of arrows at enemies, dealing Attack Damage. Recast to end early.
While in Photon Reforge state, Photon Energy consumption stops and hitting enemies recovers up to 42 Photon Energy.

Tips: Cast during Photon Reforge state to pause Photon Energy consumption and regenerate Photon Energy.

2231.EnglishLong:
Enters Focus state, greatly increasing Haste and reducing the CD of Special Attacks by 50%.

Tips: Best paired with Falconry Spec. Use it just before activating Photon Reforge for maximum uptime.

2232.EnglishLong:
Fires a rain of arrows over a target area, dealing continuous Attack Damage. Grants 20 Photon Energy upon cast, plus 2 additional Photon Energy per enemy hit, up to 10 extra.

Tips: The more enimies hit, the more energy you gain.

2233.EnglishLong:
Charges and then fires a piercing arrow that deals Attack Damage and Knockback to all enemies in its path. Reduces targets' Resilience. Powerdraw deals a bonus 100% Crit DMG
.This skill holds 2 charges.
No charge time required when in Photon Reforge state.

Tips: Great for reducing enemies' Resilience while dealing area damage.

2234.EnglishLong:
Charges and fires Photon Arrows to a target area, dealing continuous Attack Damage.
In Photon Reforge state, Photon Energy stops to decline, and more arrows are generated, dealing 50% more Attack Damage.

Tips: Cast in Photon Reforge state for bonus DMG and zero Photon Energy consumption.

2235.EnglishLong:
Leaps upward swiftly and fires at enemies, dealing Attack Damage. Grants immunity to Attack Damage for you and up to 10 nearby Allies for 5s.
This skill holds 2 charges.

Tips: This is intended to be equipped in high-pressure situations to increase survivability.

2236.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-替换普攻1

2237.EnglishLong:
Summons a powerful combat Companion to provide assistance in battle.

Summon Wild Wolf: The summoned Wild Wolf pounces on the current target, dealing Attack Damage to the target and nearby enemies, then joins the battle for 20s before disappearing.

Summon Falcon: The summoned Falcon dives in a straight line, dealing Attack Damage to all enemies in its path before disappearing.

Tips: Boosts the number of active pets during the battle. Casting is recommended when all buffs are prepared to ensure maximum efficiency.

2238.EnglishLong:
Fires an Explosive Arrow at the target that detonates on impact. The Explosive Arrow detonates on impact, dealing Attack Damage to all nearby enemies.
Each time when a Class Skill deals Crit DMG, Explosive Arrow gains 1 charge. At 5 charges or after 6s, the Explosive Arrow explodes, each charge increases the DMG of Explosive Arrow by 100%.

Tips: Better paired with Falconry Spec. Focus on Crit DMG to power up the explosion.

2290.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-聚怪虚拟体

2291.ChineseShort: 罗特罗亚尼-弓-大招爆炸

2306.EnglishLong:
Instantly releases a powerful sonic wave, dealing Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Heals nearby allies and grants a Shield that decays over time. The Shield decays every 0.5s, lasting for 10s. Doubles the Performance Passion cap and fully restores Performance Passion.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: A powerful emergency shield to ease team survival pressure. Time the cast to minimize shield decay. Once fully charged with Performance Passion, trigger burst.

2307.EnglishLong:
Consumes 3 Performance Passion to play a healing tune, healing yourself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP. Healing scales with MATK.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: High coverage healing skill. Use it before your Performance Passion overflows.

2308.EnglishLong:
Leap high and slam your guitar into the ground to burst sparks, dealing Magic Damage to the enemies within range.
Each instance of DMG dealt by Amplified Beat (only once per multi-target hit) increases the hit count of Harmonic Anthem by 1, up to 3.

Tips: Master the Amplified Beat's mechanic of increasing hit count to boost Harmonic Anthem's Attack.

2309.EnglishLong:
My Passion Still Burns! Consumes 5 points of Performance Passion to summon a randomly shaped graffiti on the ground, healing 10 allies (Party Members Prioritized), dispelling negative effects on them, and dealing Magic Damage to enemies within range.
While standing within the graffiti, the summoner gains 10% Fire Bonus.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Tips: This skill has the widest range for both healing and DMG. Cast it once the CD ends for max effectiveness.

2310.EnglishLong:
A rousing melody. When Performance Energy exceeds 15 stacks, you can begin the performance, which cannot be stopped once started. CD: 5s.
While Heroic Melody is being performed, 6 Performance Energy is consumed per second, and every 3s, 10 allies restore HP (Interval affected by Haste).
While Heroic Melody is being performed, every 7s, your String Strike transforms into Fierce Strike.
While Heroic Melody is being performed, the conversion rate of Peaceful Tune +50%.

Performance Energy: Required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody and Healing Melody). 1 point of energy is regenerated per second.

Tips: The skill can't be stopped manually, so time its activation wisely to maximize synergy with Peaceful Tune and Fierce Strike.

2311.EnglishLong:
A soothing melody. When Performance Energy is above 15, you can start the performance freely and stop at will. Each time you start, a speaker is deployed to perform a Concerto. (Speaker disappears when Healing Melody ends.) CD: 5s.
While performing Healing Melody, consumes 3 Performance Energy per second, and heals 10 allies every 1 second (Interval affected by Haste).
Speaker: When you cast Healing Beat, Fivefold Crescendo, Rock the Stage, Concert Circuit, the speaker will simultaneously cast the same skill.

Performance Energy: Required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody, Healing Melody). Regenerates 1 point per second.

Tips: Mastering where and when to place the speaker is essential.

2312.EnglishLong:
Let the Passion Flow Again! Consumes 3 Performance Passion, reigniting the spirits of the weary. Performs a sequence of notes that heals 10 allies.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: Highest healing potential. Monitor team health to avoid overhealing.

2313.EnglishLong:
Strums the strings and releases searing flames forward, dealing Magic Damage to the enemies within range and dispelling negative effects for up to 10 allies (Party Members Prioritized).
Charging changes the skill's range and DMG.
Tier 1: Chants for 0.7s, affects a fan-shaped area with an 8-meter radius in front.
Tier 2: Chants for 1.4s, affects a fan-shaped area with an 8-meter radius in front, increases the DMG dealt by 50%.
Tier 3: Chants for 2.1s, affects a fan-shaped area with an 8-meter radius in front, increases the DMG dealt by 100%.

Tips: Delivers massive DMG. When paired with Speaker and talents, it offers potent DMG and Healing. Be mindful of your surroundings during casting.

2315.EnglishLong:
The perfect piece for fan interaction. Grants Encore effect to 10 allies for 10s.
Encore: Super Armor. Each time an offensive or healing Expertise Skill is cast, there is a 50% fixed chance to trigger Encore Strings once, dealing DMG to the current target or healing the lowest-HP ally.

Tips: Cast during team burst windows for optimal DMG and Healing of Encore.

2316.EnglishLong:
Increases your MATK for some time and amplifies the next skill you cast.

Special Attack: Your next 2 Special Attacks do not consume Performance Passion.
Fivefold Crescendo: Doubles the healing instances.
Heroic Melody: Halves the time needed to trigger Fierce Strike.
Harmonic Anthem: Doubles the DMG dealt.
Passion Burst: Allows for direct cast in its strongest form, no chanting required.

Tips: Evaluate the battle environment and your combat style, then apply the appropriate enhancement at the optimal moment.

2317.EnglishLong:
Swings your guitar with force, dealing Magic Damage equal to 300% ATK to nearby enemies. Harmonic Anthem instantly gains 1 charge. Scales with the Level/Tier of Basic Attack.

Tips: Cast this skill when Harmonic Anthem is on CD.

2321.EnglishLong:
Peaceful Tune
A magical melody that, whenever DMG is dealt, restores HP equal to 20% of the DMG dealt, distributed evenly among up to 5 allies (Party Members Prioritized).
Allies at full HP will not be included in the healing targets. If all Allies are at full HP, the healing will be considered as excess healing.
Performance Energy: Energy required to play Melody skills (Heroic Melody and Healing Melody). 1 point is regenerated per second.
Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Basic Attack: String Strike
Strikes the guitar's sideboard to produce a frenzied wave, dealing Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Tips: Using Basic Attacks when Performance Passion and Performance Energy are not maxed out provides consistent healing. Pair with talents to store this healing for emergency use.

2330.ChineseShort: 灵魂乐手炎舞奏者强化

2332.EnglishLong:
Channels for 6s and continuously spews searing flames forward, dealing Magic Damage equal to 1000% ATK in total to the enemies within range.

Tips: Move continuously and try to maximize DMG dealt while staying safe.

2335.EnglishLong:
Instantly releases a powerful sonic wave, dealing Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Heals nearby allies and grants a Shield that decays over time. The Shield decays every 0.5s, lasting for 10s. Doubles the Performance Passion cap and fully restores Performance Passion.

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. Regenerates 1 stack every 5s.

Tips: A powerful emergency shield to ease team survival pressure. Time the cast to minimize shield decay. Once fully charged with Performance Passion, trigger burst.

2336.EnglishLong:
A mobile performance melody. While performing, continuously heals allies. Deals Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Each healed ally increases healing by 6%, up to 30%. Each enemy hit increases DMG by 6%, up to 30%.

Tips: Sustained healing and DMG. Adjust your position based on the number and location of targets to maximize efficiency.

2405.EnglishLong:
Consumes 1 Holy Sigil to deliver a powerful shield bash to enemies in front, dealing Attack Damage and increasing your Armor, stacking up to 3 times.

Tips: Monitor the Armor buff from Valor Bash and try to keep it active at all times.

2406.EnglishLong:
Consumes 1 Holy Sigil. After a brief charge, perform a fierce sweep forward, dealingAttack Damage and gaining 2 stacks of Lightforged Barrier.

Lightforged Barrier: Each stack increases max HP by 2%, up to 10 stacks. Taking any DMG consumes 1 stack. The Barrier lasts 25s or until all stacks are consumed. Gaining a new stack refreshes the duration.

Tips: Maintain high stacks of Lightforged Barrier while weaving in attacks. Pay attention to the use of Vanguard Hunt to trigger bonus effects.

2407.EnglishLong:
Unleashes holy energy to strike nearby enemies, dealing Attack Damage and inflicting Dazzled for 5s. Grants a Radiant Shield equal to 300% ATK. For the next 10s, instantly refreshes 1 Holy Seal for every 2s (prioritizing the Holy Seal with the longest remaining CD), and generates 10 Photon Energy each time.

Radiant Shield: Infuses the Shield with light, absorbing 50% of incoming DMG. The effect can stack absorption and reset duration when the Skill is reused. Max absorption cannot exceed 100% of Max HP.

Tips: Instantly boosts survivability and generates Holy Sigil and Photon Energy. Time the casts wisely.

2408.EnglishLong:
Tosses the spinning shield, taunting nearby enemies, dealing Attack Damage, interrupting their actions, and reducing their DMG dealt by 10% for 10s.

Tips: Boosts survivability while unleashing wide-range DMG, ideal for handling multiple targets with strategic timing based on defense and battlefield needs.

2409.EnglishLong:
Creates a holy zone beneath your feet, healing yourself every second and healing allies in the area slightly, dealing Attack Damage to enemies.

Tips: Great for sustained DMG and healing. Try to cover as much area as possible.

2410.EnglishLong:
Consumes 45 Photon Energy to call down a blast of holy light on the target area, dealing Attack Damage and healing yourself based on HP lost (minimum heal: 5% of Max HP).

Tips: Cast when your HP is low—but not critically low—to maximize healing while staying safe.

2412.EnglishLong:
Consumes 2 Holy Sigils. Performs a fiery blade strike at all nearby enemies, dealing Attack Damage.

Tips: Powerful offensive skill. Use when survivability is not an issue..

2413.EnglishLong: Enhanced <linktext=1563><style="ItemQuality_5">Reckoning</style></linktext>, whose DMG is equal to <style="accent-gn">2</style> times that of <linktext=1563><style="ItemQuality_5">Reckoning</style></linktext>, and does not consume <style="accent-gn">Holy Sigil</style>but can still generate Holy <style="accent-gn">Energy</style>.

2414.EnglishLong:
Holy Barrier
Consumes Holy Energy to raise your shield and emit the energy. Protects you and allies in a half-circle behind you, absorbing all incoming DMG within the area. The shield vanishes upon reaching its max absorb limit.

2415.EnglishLong:
Summon Aegis Ward to shield yourself, automatically counterattacking High-threat Skills while increasing Armor and DMG Reduction. If you takes fatal amount of DMG while this skill is active, the status is consumed to prevent death and immediately restore 25% HP.

Tips: Powerful DMG RED effect combined with death prevention, extremely valuable when facing intense survival pressure.

2416.EnglishLong: Deals <style="physical">Attack Damage</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">200%</style> ATK to the enemy (which scales with the Level/Tier of <style="accent-gn">Basic Attack</style>).

2417.EnglishLong: Enhanced <linktext=1563><style="ItemQuality_5">Condemn</style></linktext>, whose DMG is equal to <style="accent-gn">2</style>times that of <linktext=1563><style="ItemQuality_5">Conviction</style></linktext>.

2419.EnglishLong:
Consumes up to 8 stacks of Lightforged Barrier, summoning continuous radiant energy to spiral rapidly around you. Each second, it deals Attack Damage to nearby enemies (interval affected by Attack Speed) and grants 1 stack of Lightforged Barrier.
Each time it deals DMG to 1 target, restores 1% max HP (up to 5%). When activated, each stack of Lightforged Barrier adds 2s to the duration, up to a maximum of 16s.

Lightforged Barrier: Max HP +2% with each stack. Lightforged Barrier stacks up to 10 times. Any incoming DMG consumes 1 stack. The effect lasts 25s or until all stacks are consumed. Duration resets each time a new stack is gained.

Tips: Cast Lightforged Barrier to deal DMG and heal. Cast the skill when Lightforged Barrier is fully stacked to achieve excellent defense and burst potential.

2420.EnglishLong:
Unwavering resolve is gained, initiating the hurling of 5 shields toward the nearest enemy targets within a 10-meter radius, with priority given to those in closest proximity. Attack Damage is inflicted, and interruptions and taunt are applied to the targets. Subsequently, a single shield is thrown at 2s intervals, with 1 throw yielding 10 Photon Energy. In the next 10s, reduces each instance of DMG taken by a specified percentage of Max HP, and any High-threat Skills encountered during this period are automatically counterattacked.

Tips: This skill does not consume Photon Energy or Holy Sigil to cast, and it provides strong survivability, making it ideal as an opening move.

2421.EnglishLong:
Consumes 3 Holy Sigils, summoning a sword from beneath the target's feet to deal Attack Damage to the target, while gaining 5 layers of Lightforged Barrier.

Lightforged Barrier: Each stack increases the final Max HP by 2%. You can have up to 10 layers of Lightforged Barrier, and any damage taken will consume 1 layer. It lasts for 25s or until all layers are consumed, and the duration resets each time a layer is gained.

Tips: While having considerable damage capability, it can efficiently replenish Lightforged Barrier.

2425.EnglishLong:
Shield Toss
Consumes Light Energy, spinning and throwing the shield, dealing Attack Damage to enemies it hits, and reducing all damage they deal to oneself for a period of time.

3000.EnglishLong:
Leaps forward and smash into the ground, dealing DMG to all enemies in an area based on your max HP.
Then gains Fervor, granting yourself and allies Super Armor and Defense.

3002.EnglishLong:
Gathers surrounding energy to pull all enemies within 30 meters to you, inflicting taunt.
Gain Defense for a period of time.
Passive Effect:Thorn.

3102.EnglishLong: Weaves Energy into a <linktext=1035><style="ItemQuality_5">Shield</style></linktext>. While active, if under a <linktext=1083><style="ItemQuality_5">Wounded</style></linktext> state, gain bonus <style="accent-gn">Shield Defense</style>.

3103.EnglishLong:
Summon a decoy that taunts all enemies within 5 meters.
The decoy disappears after taking a certain amount of DMG.

3104.EnglishLong: Inflicts a Hostility Mark on all enemies within 5 meters. Marked enemies will increasingly build up Hostility on you, and every attack against them restores your HP.

3105.EnglishLong:
Smashes the ground 5 meters ahead, causing a shockwave that stuns all enemies in the area.
If the enemy possesses Super Armor, it will instead deal high Super Armor DMG.
Dodging a High-threat Skill successfully resets its CD immediately.

3106.EnglishLong: Raises an energy shield in front to block enemies' <linktext=1068><style="ItemQuality_5">projectiles</style></linktext>.

3301.EnglishLong: Calls down divine energy to heal yourself and all <style="accent-gn">allies</style>, and reduces the <style="accent-gn">CD </style> of all your Weapon skills.

3302.EnglishLong:
Summon a gravitational singularity, continuously drawing in nearby enemies. Units affected by the singularity are subjected to periodic DMG and become stunned.
If the enemy possesses Super Armor, it will instead deal high Super Armor DMG.

3303.EnglishLong: Activates and amplifies the Battlelust aura, drastically reducing the movement speed and Armor of all enemies in the area. All allies within the range gain greatly increased Armor and are healed every 3s.

3402.EnglishLong: Instantly heals yourself and nearby <style="accent-gn">allies</style>, and randomly <style="accent-gn">dispel</style> a <linktext=1094><style="ItemQuality_5">debuff</style></linktext>.

3403.EnglishLong: Creates a <linktext=1072><style="ItemQuality_5">Field</style></linktext>, continuously healing<style="accent-gn">allies</style> within it.

3404.EnglishLong: Protects nearby <style="accent-gn">allies</style>, healing them <style="accent-gn">once</style> when they take DMG.

3405.EnglishLong: Raises a Block Shield for 2s. The Block Shield will block the next incoming hit. Successful Block reduces the CD of all your Weapon skills.

3406.EnglishLong: Unleashes formidable energy to weaken nearby <style="accent-gn">enemies</style>, reducing their <style="accent-gn">movement speed</style>. monsters below <style="accent-gn">15%</style> HP will instantly <style="accent-gn">disperse</style>.

3602.EnglishLong: Sees through enemies' all weaknesses, entering True Sight state. While active, gains increased <style="accent-gn">critical rate</style>.

3603.EnglishLong:
Focuses on your Energy and enter Charge state. While active, Consecutive Hits and Defeats generate up to 5 Engram Orbs. When the duration ends or the skill is cast again, deals DMG based on the number of orbs stored.
For every 8 hits, 1 Engram Orb is generated.
For every Defeat, 1 Engram Orb is generated.
Area damage that hits multiple targets is still counted as a single hit.

3605.EnglishLong: Burns yourself to gain power, entering Invigorated state. When active, gains a <style="accent-gn">DMG Boost</style>, but also takes more DMG.

3702.EnglishLong: Leaps into the air for a powerful strike. If the attack lands a <style="accent-gn">Crit</style>, the <style="accent-gn">CD </style> of this skill will be reset, and it can be cast up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times in succession. Each cast temporarily increases <style="accent-gn">Crit DMG</style>, stacking up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times.

3703.EnglishLong: Throws multiple daggers forward, dealing DMG to <style="accent-gn">enemies</style> and inflicting <linktext=1023><style="ItemQuality_5">Vulnerable</style></linktext>.

3704.EnglishLong:
Unleashes Sigil: Blazing Surge, dealing minor area damage and creating Blazing Traps in the area. These traps explode on contact with enemies or after a period of time, dealing DMG to surrounding enemies.
Sigil: Summon at least 2 Blazing Traps, with a chance to summon up to 5.

3705.EnglishLong: Raises a Block Shield for 2s. The Block Shield will block the next incoming hit. Successful Block reduces the CD of all your Weapon skills.

3902.EnglishLong: <style="accent-gn">Summon Boss</style>: Tempest Ogre and channels the power of thunder to generate a vortex, continuously pulling in enemies near the target and dealing AoE <style="magic">Magic Damage</style> when the duration ends.

3903.EnglishLong:
Transform into Boss: The Bear and summons a blazing giant axe, increasing ATK of the Allies within range for a period and granting yourself additional ATK boost.
(This effect cannot stack and only one can be active at a time.)

3904.EnglishLong:
Summon Elite: Muku Warrior to leap forward and deliver a powerful strike, dealing AoE Attack Damage. This attack is guaranteed to Crit.
Upon the skill cast, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a period.

3905.EnglishLong:
Summon Elite: Boarrier Tyrant and charges forward with tusks for 3s. Deals Attack Damage and knocks enemies airborne during the charge. Boarrier tusks tear through flesh, inflicting 100% Wounds on enemies hit for 15s.
Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Special Attack are increased for a period.

3906.EnglishLong:
Summon Boss: Frost Ogre to execute a spinning attack with an ice hammer, resulting in Attack Damage and freezing of all targets struck.
Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

3907.EnglishLong:
Transform into Elite: Inferno Goblin Mage and summons meteors from the sky, dealing Magic Damage and disrupting their actions.
Upon the skill cast, your Intellect is increased for a period.

3908.EnglishLong:
Summon Boss: Muku King to channel Forest Energy, healing up to 10 allies over time and dispelling debuffs.
Upon the skill cast, your healing received is increased for a period.

3909.EnglishLong: [Boss Transform] - Void Foxen. Pounces forward with blinding speed, dealing AoE <style="physical">Attack Damage</style> and increasing <style="accent-gn">Haste</style> for <style="accent-gn">20s</style>.

3910.EnglishLong: <style="accent-gn">Summon Elite</style>:  Void Ogre, roars in place, and fires 6 whirlwind-like Void Projectiles at the target, dealing <style="physical">Attack Damage</style>. Inflicts Void Corruption Decay on the target for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>, dealing <style="magic">Magic Damage</style> per second, up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> stacks. <style="accent-gn">100%</style> of the DMG dealt over time is converted into your HP.

3911.EnglishLong:
Summon Tatta to grant Battle Will to the entire team, preventing all allies from being defeated and ensuring their HP does not fall below a certain threshold for a period of time.
Exhausted: Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s (Exhausted effects are enhanced in party dungeons of Nightmare mode).

3913.EnglishLong:
Transform into Elite: Dark Mist Captain to launch an Electro Bomb at the designated target, dealing AoE Attack Damage and disrupting their actions.
Upon the skill cast, the DMG dealt and healing of your Expertise Skill are increased for a period.

3914.EnglishLong:
Summon Elite: Goblin Guard to perform multiple sword energy attacks forward, dealing Attack Damage. Sword energy hits will reduce the target's Armor.
(The effect cannot stack, and only one effect of the same type will be effective.)
Upon the skill cast, your Block DMG reduction is increased for a period.

3915.EnglishLong:
Summon Elite: Goblin Warrior to shoot in a fan-shaped area in front, dealing Attack Damage.
Upon the skill cast, your Luck and Lucky Strike Chance are increased for a period.

3916.EnglishLong: [Boss Summon] - Brigand Archer. Charges and fires a Piercing Arrow at the target, dealing <style="physical">Attack Damage</style>.

3917.EnglishLong: <style="accent-gn">Summon Elite</style>:  Dark Mist Commander to execute a forward flurry of slashes, inflicting <style="physical">Attack Damage</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">disrupting</style></linktext> the target's actions. All Heavy Slash charges are consumed in the process to significantly amplify the DMG inflicted.

3918.EnglishLong: [Boss Summon] - Crimson Foxen. Strike instantly, dealing 1 instance of <style="physical">Attack Damage</style>. Then it continues assisting the player in combat for <style="accent-gn">15s</style>. Can be directed via Storm Arrow from the Marksman.

3919.EnglishLong: [Boss Summon] - Inspecting Floating Eye. Fires continuously at the target, dealing <style="physical">Attack Damage</style>.

3920.EnglishLong: When healing is done, there is a <style="accent-gn">30%</style> chance to grant a Shield equal to <style="accent-gn">{*Decision.unmarkpercent(1)*}</style> of ATK. When the shield expires, it releases a gust of wind, dealing <style="physical">Attack Damage</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">{*Decision.unmarkpercent(2)*}</style> of ATK.

3921.EnglishLong:
Summon Tina to infuse time power, reducing the Skill CDs of yourself and up to 10 surrounding allies for a period.
(Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s.)

3922.EnglishLong: <style="accent-gn">Summon</style> Olvera to shuttle back and forth in a forward direction, drawing in enemies encountered along the path, dealing <style="physical">Attack Damage</style>, and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">disrupting</style></linktext> their actions. When dealing DMG, there is a chance to inflict Seed of Lightning on the targets for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>. Dealing DMG to targets with Seed of Lightning will cause an explosion (CD: <style="accent-gn">2s</style>), dealing <style="magic">Magic Damage</style>. Any target with Seed of Lightning defeated will reduce CD time by <style="accent-gn">20s</style>.

3923.EnglishLong:
Summons Boss: Muku Chief to slam the ground around, dealing AoE Attack Damage. Holds 2 charges.
Upon the skill cast, your Crit and Crit DMG are increased for a period.

3924.EnglishLong: Resonate with the power of Elite: Goblin Wind Mage to transform into its form. Executes a frontal cone attack that deals <style="physical">Attack Damage</style> and <linktext=3001><style="ItemQuality_5">silences</style></linktext> all affected targets.

3925.EnglishLong:
Transform into Elite: Mighty Colossus to charge and deal Attack Damage. The longer the charge, the higher the Resilience Break Efficiency. Each stack increases the Resilience Break done by 50%. (3 stacks at Tier 3 and 6 stacks at Tier 5.)
Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

3926.EnglishLong:
Summon Boss: Storm Goblin King to release a meteor shower at the target, dealing Magic Damage. Upon the skill cast, your Luck and DMG dealt and healing of Luck effects are increased for a period.
Tier 5: While active, trigger​ all unlocked ​passive Luck effects​ from your Battle Imagines.

3927.EnglishLong:
Summon Elite: Jungle Goblin Warrior and roars.
Casts the skill, temporarily boosting Strength, empowering the next attack to deal bonus Attack Damage in a limited area, and disrupting the target's actions.

3928.EnglishLong:
Summon Elite: Muku Scout to chase the target, dealing Attack Damage.
